positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for a complex government development project. Responsible for developing a web-based application using Visual Studio 2013 for Web. Lead Scrum meetings, provided guidance to developers, designed pages, solved technical issues and provided developer tasking. The web application processes collected network traffic (VoIP, chat and email) and provides analysts with a tool for reviewing the captured communications in order to develop after action reviews. The application utilizes MVC5, JavaScript, C# and Razor code to display data from SQL Server database. 

 Senior software developer at TEI working on Starship/C3 Driver/StarGen. Starship development requires XML, Java and Microsoft Visual Studio tools (VB.Net, C++, SQL Server, Visual Studio 2008/2010, Visual Studio Team System).

Network administrator. Duties include managing a Watchguard firewall, a Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft Domain controllers, a Microsoft Windows Update Server, an Asterisk-based phone system and network backups. Skills learned in troubleshooting software are used to mitigate network problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part-time Consultant. Developed software to transition ‘source’ telephone system data to the ‘target’ telephone system data. The software utilized raw output from the source switch, an SQL database, and detailed business logic to generate load commands specific to the target telephone system.  Customers included Wells Fargo Bank, Northrup Grumman, and Baylor University Hospitals.
